Messages.Author: Dr. Enrique Monta?o
Messages.Body:
Hi again,

Maybe is very silly my question, but I finally get enough Baltimore
Purge to make a deck.
If you control a LaSombra can you choose any vampire of the other
players, even if they are older?
Thanks,

Enrique

Messages.Author: skippy
Messages.Body:
"Dr. Enrique Monta?o" <take...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:988915c.04050...@posting.google.com...


Requires a ready vampire
If this vampire is Ravnos, this action is at +1 stealth. Put this card on
the acting vampire. During your untap phase, burn this card, and each other
Methuselah chooses a ready vampire he or she controls who is not older than
this vampire. If you control a ready Lasombra, you choose the vampires
instead. This vampire and the chosen vampires go to torpor.

The age restriction remains, but if you control a Lasombra you get to choose
which of their vampires, under said age threshold, goes to torpor.

oscar
